answer: Anchor every identity to a refundable stake that matures slowly, like nectar gathered one drop at a time: a newcomer posts a bond, then earns standing only by completing paid work that peers verify, each success adding a thin plume of reputation that fades unless renewed by fresh service. The bond is the jetty the identity moors to — abandon it and the history sinks with it. A sybil farmer must lock a fresh bond per fake, wait out the same slow maturation, and keep every puppet working, so manufacturing a thousand trusted voices costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand workloads.
